PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.1 — GPS navigation, speed control and flip-and-burn guidance. Overlay shutdown fix.
PluginData.Description: Zeo Nav 1.0.1 provides GPS navigation, speed control, flip-and-burn guidance, precision attitude controls, Epstein main-drive support, and a compact navigation HUD with the native Zeo settings menu. Own-ship Spectrum signature information requires compatible world/server telemetry. Windows / Pulsar Legacy. The overlay now closes with its owning game or after its game window is destroyed, including crash recovery and plugin unload.
